note: BH-10218: settings row lane.dequeue-watch.dqw_provider_backstop_s. The longest dequeue-watch serves a repo's stored merge-queue provider word (state/dequeue-watch/provider/) with no push wake to the repo's default branch. After it, or after a push, the tick asks mc_queue_provider again (.mergify.yml and rulesets through gh_rest, ETag on). Only a real read is stored; a failed read stores nothing. 0 = no store: every tick reads, as before BH-10218. Code fallback 21600 (DQW_PROVIDER_BACKSTOP_DEFAULT in bin/lib/dequeue-watch/provider-memo.sh).
